items.summary: Implement a real ICRC-1-compatible SUZHI token ledger in the existing Motoko single-actor canister (backend/main.mo), replacing the current in-memory-only balance Map behavior so balances are minted, transferred, and queried via ICRC-1 semantics.

Mint the full initial SUZHI supply of 1_000_000_000 exactly once to the configured owner principal (2psws-zhgt3-afmzp-mjr66-z74ph-qbyjh-zdc6u-b4yku-y7qm3-zl2ev-2ae), ensuring it cannot double-mint on redeploy/upgrade (use a persisted initialMintCompleted guard).

Update backend transfer/balance APIs to be consistent: either (a) keep the existing backend methods used by the current frontend (getBalance(principal) and transfer(to, amount)) as backward-compatible wrappers around the ICRC-1 ledger, or (b) update the frontend React Query hooks and wallet UI to call the ICRC-1 transfer/balance endpoints. Ensure user-facing text remains in English.

Ensure all token ledger state required for balances, total supply, mint-guard (initialMintCompleted), and any token metadata is preserved across upgrades using stable state and, if applicable, backend/migration.mo under the project's conditional migration policy.
